text:
Maya: Quick sync - MarlinPay procurement needs a one-page acceptance + cost delta for reserved vs burst before legal signs. They care most about tail latency under sustained load.
Diego: They asked for p95 <220ms, p99 <550ms at 220 QPS. i'd rather propose p95 <280ms / p99 <700ms so we don't fail on noisy neighbors.
Iris: traffic mix i'll use: 60% short gen (~40 tokens), 25% long gen (~180 tokens), 15% embeddings. will attach k6 mix to the poc bucket.
Diego: run config: batching=8, prefix cache ON, prewarm 12m, pin model to rwd-chat-2.0-prod.
Maya: security checklist they require: IP allowlist for load agents, KMS integration statement, audit log retention, and a signed test consent. SecOps, confirm wording?
SecOps: KMS: hosted supports customer-key via connector; Private supports CMK. Audit logs retained 90 days by default. i'll post the copy-paste text in the folder.
Maya: runbook proposal:
- smoke: 5 QPS x 3m
- ramp: 5 -> 220 QPS over 12m
- steady: 220 QPS x 30m
- surge: 440 QPS x 90s x 2 iterations (validate graceful fallback)
Command we'll run:
```
k6 run --vus 230 --duration 32m marlin_mix.js
```
PerfBot: note: enable detailed tracing for the ramp and steady windows to capture kv_hit and token-level latency.
Diego: metrics to capture for the acceptance sheet: p50/p95/p99, success_rate, tokens_per_sec, kv_hit_rate, gpu_util, 5xx_count, model_version.
Iris: quick dev run (informal): p95=180ms p99=420ms @125 QPS with batch=8 on a single A100-equivalent. dev cluster so take with a grain.
Maya: pricing roughs for the appendix: reserved pool for 220 QPS ~= $21k/mo, optional burst cushion to 440 QPS amortized ~= +$4.2k/mo. flag: exact depends on avg tokens/seq length.
Diego: proposed acceptance criteria to present:
- sustain 220 QPS for 30m, success_rate >= 99.5%
- p95 < 280ms, p99 < 700ms
- no unplanned 5xx during steady window; graceful degradation validated during surge
Maya: i'll send the one-pager + IP CIDR request to the buyer. once they return sign-off, we'll schedule a 2hr window next week and tag ops.
SecOps: SOC2 link and audit text uploaded to /shared/pocs/marlinpay/ :white_check_mark:
Iris: uploaded k6 scripts and payloads to the poc bucket and pasted link.
Maya: thanks team  locking this down after buyer ack. :thumbsup:
